answer: Prayers & Duties >> Waqf, Mosque, Madrasa Question ID: 9796 Country: India Title: WHAT IS THE BEST PLACE FOR NIKHA MASJID OR BAZAR FANCTION HALL WHAT ISLAM SAY ABOUT THIS MATTER SEND FATWA. Question: assalamualikum WHAT IS THE BEST PLACE FOR NIKHA MASJID OR BAZAR FANCTION HALL WHAT ISLAM SAY ABOUT THIS MATTER SEND FATWA KHUDA HAFIZ Answer ID: 9796 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2381/2117=D/1429) It is sunnah to perform Nikah in mosque. The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: أ علنوا بالنکاح واجعلوہ في المساجد ( مشکوۃ 272 ) Make your Nikah public and perform it in mosque. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
